description: Long-window rule: 60 pods, ~30 req/s from ~96 sites every ~3.2 s against a 2,000 per hour limit with 1 min buckets, two over-limit hot keys and a 90 req/s burst for 60 s. The first full window (3,600 s) is warmed up with real traffic; 1,200 s are measured. The load is a tenth of the 300 req/s first proposed: that implies ~1.1 M live cells per pod, more than 7 GB and several hours per run, and 170x the reference deployment's live-cell count.
